description: Current `git am` series 0001-0058 on bb15fcb. Includes: integ3 + pipeline RAM fix (bounded lookahead, free each step), transcript Poseidon2 delta, eccvm (rebased), fields2, msm2/0002, msm/0002 (tests), pcs on-integ3 (6), stdlib 0005-0007, sumcheck2 on-integ3 (4), circuit/0005 (revised), wasm build flags, wasm-poly 0003-0004. Fixes integ4's RAM regression: peak RSS is now 6.5% below par. Not included: wasm-poly/0001-0002 (conflict with newer native polynomial changes), joint2 (no reproducible gain), pcs/0002-0003 originals (superseded), wasm-threads (diagnostic only).
